stem:
Meera wants to find the density of a stone at home in Jaipur. She will measure its mass and its volume, then calculate density.

Which procedure should she follow before using her measurements?

options.text: Read the balance without checking the zero, then pour any amount of water into the measuring cylinder
Zero the balance before measuring the mass, then read the water level in the measuring cylinder at eye level before and after adding the stone
Measure the volume first and guess the mass by holding the stone in her hand
Use the highest mark on the measuring cylinder as the volume of the stone

teacher.key_rationale: Density needs accurate mass and volume. The balance must be zeroed (tared) before measuring mass, and the volume of the stone is found by the rise in water level in the measuring cylinder read at eye level. Only option B describes this correct procedure; A skips zeroing, C guesses mass, and D misuses the cylinder scale.
